title: JANUS Engine — dedicated research-branch manifest
purpose: Structured index for JANUS Engine architecture, simulations, literature crawls and staged validation without prematurely merging research conclusions into main.

branching_policy.rule: Existing canonical JANUS Engine records remain inherited at data/ paths; branch-specific gates, simulations and research live under projects/janus-engine/.

MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.flow: water -> POMS artificial gill -> low-pO2 recirculating cathode gas -> PEMFC -> electricity -> auxiliaries
MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.reason: avoids bulk O2/N2 separation, N2 service and LOX during first ignition

MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.flow: dissolved-gas extraction -> conditioning -> O2/N2 separation -> O2 use/storage + N2 cooling/regeneration/inert cascade -> optional cryogenic branch

latest_findings.startup_lesson: self-drive is a transient state transition; readiness is state convergence rather than t=0 behavior
latest_findings.scale_management: Use low-hardness initial fill, candidate low-dose anti-adhesion chemistry only after compatibility tests, rotating near-wall Axle/wipers, centrifugal solids transport and removable crystal traps / washable filters.
latest_findings.vane_energy_result: If the same local pump supplies the pressure drop across an Axle vane, recovered shaft power is always smaller than added pump power for realistic efficiencies. Therefore vanes are primarily anti-scale/flow-conditioning elements; external-current energy recovery is a separate case and must charge drag.
latest_findings.crystal_trap_result: Normalized sensitivity shows strong multiplicative benefit when trap capture and Axle scraping are combined, but actual eta_trap and eta_scraper remain measurement gates rather than assumed hardware performance.
latest_findings.calcium_product_boundary: Recovered solids are recorded as CaCO3-rich mineral product until composition and use-specific qualification justify a stronger material claim.

current_project_state.dominant_boss: Measure long-duration coupled oxygen flux, hydraulic/rotational parasitics and calcium partitioning under real water chemistry.

next_actions: Run A0/A1/A2/A3 factorial: stationary/no-trap, trap-only, rotating-Axle-only, and combined rotating-Axle + trap.
Log wall CaCO3 mass, trap/filter mass, Axle torque, DeltaP, pump/drive watts and POMS J_O2 over a long hold.
Measure incremental vane DeltaP separately from useful scraper/flow-distribution benefit.
Use the external-current energy-recovery branch only where the external hydraulic source and corresponding drag are explicitly budgeted.
Replace normalized trap/scraper sensitivity parameters with measured efficiencies before lifetime or maintenance-interval claims.
